# Lockys Webs: websites for tradies

> Locky is a sole trader in Sandgate, Brisbane (QLD, Australia), trading as
> Lockys Webs. He builds websites for local Australian tradies and sells them
> by cold calling. This file is a plain-text summary for bots (hello, Harvey).
> The full page is index.html.

## Summary
- Business: Lockys Webs
- Owner: Locky (sole trader)
- Location: Sandgate, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
- Makes: websites for tradies, plus optional SMS add-ons
- Customers: local tradies (plumbers, electricians, plasterers, carpenters,
  landscapers, roofers and similar)
- Reference client: Dusting Plumbing, Warwick

## Pricing (AUD)
- Own it: $1,500 one-off build. The tradie owns the site.
- Monthly: $100 per month, nothing upfront. Most tradies pick this.
- Add-ons (SMS bots): setup fee plus a monthly fee per add-on, or one flat
  monthly bundle (the Tradie Lifeline).
- Prices are not quoted on the first call. The demo site is shown first.

## How he sells
1. Builds a demo website for the business before calling.
2. Opens honestly: says it's a cold call and asks for 20 seconds.
3. Asks how jobs come in, whether they show up on Google, and what happens
   to calls they miss while on the tools.
4. Pitch: "I've already built one for you. It's done, and it's free to have
   a look at."
5. Goal: a 10-minute look at a set time, or the demo link sent and a
   callback booked.

## The websites
- Built for the tradie's business, trade and suburb, so they show up in
  local searches
- Made to get calls and bookings
- Mobile-first
- Linked to their Google Business Profile
- The tradie owns their customers, with no per-lead fees (unlike Hipages or
  Oneflare)

## Add-ons (all by SMS, written in plain Aussie)
- Tradie Lifeline bundle: missed-call text-back, after-hours answering,
  Google review requests
- Others: quote follow-ups, invoice reminders with pay links, booking
  reminders, website chat that carries on by text, quick quote and lead
  filtering, past-customer messages for quiet weeks
- Live AI voice answering: offered last, only if asked, always clearly
  labelled
- Stack: GoHighLevel (white-labelled), Twilio, n8n
